denied_actions.close_viewer: pairs with open_viewer, which is not served
denied_actions.create_world: replaces the world the peer's mesh robots live in; spawn a new peer instead
denied_actions.destroy: destroys the world under the peer, which stays up answering nothing useful
denied_actions.eval_policy: a rollout; the execute action carries it with its own allowlists
denied_actions.evaluate_benchmark: a rollout; the execute action carries it with its own allowlists
denied_actions.load_scene: reads a host path and replaces the world the peer's mesh robots live in
denied_actions.open_viewer: opens a window on the peer host
denied_actions.register_benchmark_from_file: reads a path on the peer host
denied_actions.register_urdf: reads a path on the peer host
denied_actions.replace_scene_mjcf: replaces the world; arbitrary MJCF can reference host files
denied_actions.replay_episode: reads a dataset from the peer's disk or the Hub; no rail carries datasets
denied_actions.run_policy: a rollout; the execute action carries it with its own allowlists
denied_actions.start_policy: a rollout; the start action carries it with its own allowlists

denied_params.mesh_path: a path on the peer host
denied_params.output_dir: a path on the peer host; the peer's own default applies
denied_params.output_path: a path on the peer host; the peer's own default applies
denied_params.push_to_hub: an egress switch; the peer decides what leaves it
denied_params.root: a path on the peer host; the peer's own dataset home applies
denied_params.scene_path: a path on the peer host
denied_params.spec_path: a path on the peer host
denied_params.urdf_path: a path on the peer host
denied_params.xml: raw MJCF can reference host files
